node.title: L1 Mersenne HNF m=16 order-one constant-color reduction
node.statement: On the official m=16,h=15 row, a constant color forces rho*c=1-alpha and 182alpha(c-1)=(alpha+1)zeta+28alpha^2. Norm contraction reduces the chamber to two explicit quadratic gcds against the degree-nine mu_16 trace polynomial over F_8191.
node.notes: Exact constant-color reduction layer. Its downstream modular pseudo-remainder theorem proves both gcds unit without Modal; degrees four through thirteen and all inner conditions remain open.
